description: Render a URL in Chrome for Testing with a real device preset (viewport, DPR, mobile UA/touch) and return a PNG screenshot plus layout diagnostics (horizontal overflow + offending elements, safe-area insets, media features, viewport/screen sizes). Use it to check mobile/web layouts, responsive bugs, and before/after fixes.

device.description: Device id or name, e.g. iphone16, "iPhone 15 Pro", ipadpro11, px10 (default iphone16)

fullPage.description: Capture the full scrollable page (default: viewport only)

scrollY.description: Scroll to this Y offset before capture

selector.description: Wait for this CSS selector before capture

waitMs.description: Extra wait after load before capture (default 1200)

name: capture_page
